metadata_contract_matrix.repository_evidence: ohlcv_data.open_time and market_events.start_time/end_time represent when the underlying market interval or event occurred.

metadata_contract_matrix.repository_evidence: stale_price_guard.validate_venue_quote and data_provenance_score expose quote_age_ms/freshness_ms (relative latency), not an absolute observation timestamp on contract surfaces.
metadata_contract_matrix.semantic_limitations: Relative quote_age_ms/freshness_ms does not prove an absolute observation timestamp.

metadata_contract_matrix.repository_evidence: blackdark/data/response_metadata.resolve_data_state compares latest_record_at to SLA freshness thresholds; no available_at field exists in schemas or APIs.
metadata_contract_matrix.semantic_limitations: latest_record_at plus SLA/freshness does not prove earliest availability to the Temporal PIT process.

metadata_contract_matrix.repository_evidence: ohlcv_data.fetched_at column exists; data_provenance.parsed_at aliased fetched_at in get_provenance_by_record; ingestion_runs.started_at records run start.
metadata_contract_matrix.semantic_limitations: fetched_at, parsed_at, and ingestion-run start may support derivation but do not automatically prove per-record ingestion timestamp.

metadata_contract_matrix.repository_evidence: No effective_at column or equivalent domain-effectiveness timestamp located in inspected DG schemas or services.
